subject.title: [Bug][iOS] chat.history reconciliation duplicates and reorders replies after tool runs

question: Is the detailed v2026.7.1 Gateway trace sufficient to sponsor a shared Apple reconciliation change, or must the reporter first provide a redacted event capture or deterministic replay fixture that identifies the exact competing event order?
rationale: The bug and affected boundary are credible, but multiple event sources can produce the final visual state and choosing the wrong race would create fragile deduplication behavior in shared iOS/macOS chat.

options.title: Require replay-grade evidence
options.body: Request a redacted ordered event/RPC capture or equivalent deterministic fixture, then implement against the demonstrated convergence failure.

options.title: Sponsor supervised source fix
options.body: Accept the current trace as sufficient and have an Apple chat owner implement and validate the reconciliation invariant on device or simulator.

options.title: Wait for another native reproduction
options.body: Leave the issue open without code work until an owner independently reproduces the behavior on current main.

recommendation.title: Require replay-grade evidence
recommendation.body: Request a redacted ordered event/RPC capture or equivalent deterministic fixture, then implement against the demonstrated convergence failure.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the closest prior reconciliation fix and are well positioned to judge whether this evidence clears the proof threshold for another shared Apple state change.
